summary: Backend-only regression for MAK FIN PAY after complete removal of agent_code system. 22/22 pytest tests passed (100%). Verified email+password-only login for all roles, no agent_code in any response/audit/index, full wallet lifecycle (recharge approve -> credit, bill payment debit, admin reject refund, withdrawal create + reject refund), admin stats, and MongoDB users collection now has only _id_ and email_1 indexes (legacy agent_code index dropped).

minor.issue: Email is silently lowercased on create but no client-facing note; could surprise UI if it stores casing locally. Cosmetic only.
For admin role returns {'balance': 0} (plain dict) while for others returns full wallet doc — inconsistent response shape.

allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False — login cookie won't be accepted by browsers cross-origin; frontend works via Bearer token so functional, but cookie-based auth is effectively dead. Consider explicit origins + allow_credentials=True if cookies are needed.

action_items: (Optional) Normalize /api/wallet response shape between admin and non-admin roles.
(Optional) Tighten CORS if cookie-based auth is to be relied upon.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~770 lines and combines auth, uploads, wallet, recharge, bill payment, withdrawal, KYC, QR, settings, audit and stats — split into routers/modules for maintainability before it grows further.
Bcrypt hash format verified ($2b$) via successful login. Good.
Startup correctly drops legacy agent_code* indexes and $unsets agent_code on existing admin doc — confirmed.
seed_admin is idempotent and re-hashes password if it changed — matches playbook expectation.
No brute-force lockout implemented (playbook expects lockout after 5 failed logins). Not in scope for this iteration but noted.
set_cookie uses secure=False — fine for preview but should be True in production.

distributor_create_agent: commission validated against admin min/max — good. But create_subuser fallback can still set commission outside range when called by admin without explicit value (admin path bypasses range check). Consider validating uniformly.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI — should migrate to lifespan handlers.
test_credentials: Admin: makfinpay@gmail.com / Riyaz@1212. TEST_ prefixed distributors/agents auto-created and cleaned up in teardown.
seed_data_creation: Per-run TEST_dist_<suffix>@example.com and TEST_agent_dist_<suffix>@example.com created and torn down via session fixture (delete_many on regex ^TEST_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-use /app/backend/tests/test_makfinpay_no_agent_code.py as the regression suite. It is fully idempotent (unique suffix per run + teardown). Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_makfinpay_no_agent_code.py -v. Confirms agent_code removal end-to-end, full wallet/recharge/bill/withdrawal flow, audit, stats, and Mongo indexes.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing functionality. One initial test assertion failed because backend (correctly) lowercases emails; test was updated to compare case-insensitively.
